**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2467813)

**Proposed mechanism:** Variant in NDE1 (rs113697910) —DISRUPTS→ NDE1 (HGNC:17878); NDE1 (HGNC:17878) —LEADS_TO→ Mitochondrial dynamics (GO:0007005); Mitochondrial dynamics (GO:0007005) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Variant in ANAPC7 (rs141027789) —DISRUPTS→ ANAPC7 (HGNC:28578); ANAPC7 (HGNC:28578) —LEADS_TO→ Anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome (APC/C) regulation (GO:0000050); Anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome (APC/C) regulation (GO:0000050) —LEADS_TO→ Global developmental delay (HP:0001263). Loss-of-function variants in NDE1 disrupt mitochondrial dynamics, leading to intellectual disability. Concurrently, loss-of-function variants in ANAPC7 impair APC/C regulation, contributing to global developmental delay. While NDE1 is involved in mitochondrial function and ANAPC7 in cell cycle control, both are crucial for proper neuronal development and function, hence their mutations converge on neurodevelopmental phenotypes.

**How to falsify it:** Absence of mutations in NDE1 or ANAPC7 in individuals with MONDO:0011504 or Ferguson-Bonni neurodevelopmental syndrome, respectively, or the identification of pathogenic variants in these genes in unaffected individuals at a frequency greater than 0.1% in gnomAD. _(variant: rs113697910, rs141027789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared molecular basis of these neurodevelopmental disorders could reveal common therapeutic targets for improving neuronal function and cognitive outcomes.

#### 5. complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.437)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2467813, Reactome:R-HSA-380320)

**Proposed mechanism:** TUBB2B (HGNC:12070) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal organization and dynamics (GO:0007010); NDE1 (HGNC:17849) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal organization and dynamics (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal organization and dynamics (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Brain malformation (HP:0002670); Cytoskeletal organization and dynamics (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Cortical malformation (HP:0031044). Mutations in both TUBB2B and NDE1 disrupt the fundamental cellular process of cytoskeletal organization and dynamics, leading to various brain malformations characteristic of both conditions.

**How to falsify it:** The discovery of pathogenic variants in TUBB2B or NDE1 with a minor allele frequency greater than 1% in gnomAD would significantly weaken the hypothesis that these genes are the sole causal agents for these rare diseases. _(variant: gnomAD)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of TUBB2B and NDE1 in cytoskeletal organization offers potential therapeutic avenues for both conditions, possibly by targeting pathways that compensate for the loss of function or stabilize the cytoskeleton.
